meta.name: General Fitness Block A
meta.author: Gordon Carlisle
constraints: Most sessions 60-90 min; Saturday may run longer
Knee tracking protected: lateral band walks and both calf raise variations are never dropped
Weeks 1-2: all pressing and rowing seated or chest-supported, no spinal loading

baseline_from_logs.note: Phase 4 logging goes patchy after week 2. Effective layoff is closer to 5-6 weeks than 2.

nutrition.review: If bodyweight has not moved after 2 full weeks of hitting these, drop 150 calories from carbs.

protein_anchors.what: Fairlife Core Power Elite, or whey + liquid egg whites

phases.name: Ramp-in
phases.note: Find loads. Leave 3-4 reps in reserve. No barbell hip thrust. Intervals are 3 rounds, not 4.

phases.name: Build A
phases.note: Double progression. Hip thrust machine enters week 3.

phases.name: Deload
phases.note: 60% of working loads. Same reps. Mandatory, not optional.

phases.name: Build B
phases.note: Last set of the final exercise in each session taken to 1-2 reps from failure.

phases.name: Test
phases.note: Light week. Re-measure waist, weight, resting HR. DEXA re-scan if you baselined.

progression.rule: Double progression. When you hit the top of the rep range on every working set, add weight next session.

week.title: Off
week.notes: Full rest. Walk if you want, nothing structured.

week.title: Zone 2
week.prescription: 45-50 min at 122-144 bpm. Peloton, or treadmill at 3.5-4 mph and 3-5% incline. Conversational the whole way. If you cannot talk, slow down.

week.title: VO2max Intervals
week.prescription: 10 min easy warm-up. Then 4 rounds of: 4 min at 162-171 bpm, 3 min easy. 5 min cooldown. Weeks 1-2 do 3 rounds. Bike or rower preferred over running.
week.note: This is the highest-value session of your week. Do not skip it. It takes about 90 seconds of each 4-minute round to reach the target heart rate, so push from the start.

week.title: Easy (optional)
week.prescription: 45-75 min easy, under 122 bpm. Outdoors if the weather allows. This is the day you drop in a bad week. Dropping it costs you nothing.

UPPER_A.title: Upper A - Push
UPPER_A.notes: Seated and supported pressing. Finish with 10 min easy spin at Zone 2.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: Primary. 30-40 degree bench. Elbows at 45 degrees, not flared.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.note: Weeks 1-2 use the machine. From week 3 you may swap to flat dumbbell bench.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: SEATED with back support. Non-negotiable while the back settles.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: Light. Shoulder width is what makes a waist look narrow.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.note: Cable. Elbows pinned to your sides.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.note: Anti-rotation core. Back-friendly. Slow.

UPPER_B.title: Upper B - Pull
UPPER_B.notes: All rowing is chest-supported or seated. No bent-over work. Finish with 10 min easy spin.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Row (Machine)
exercises.note: Primary. Chest stays on the pad. Drive elbows back, squeeze.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.note: Wide grip. Pull to the collarbone, not behind the neck.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.note: Neutral grip. Do not rock. Torso stays still.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.note: Rope at eye height. Posture insurance for a desk job.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: Seated or standing. No swinging.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.note: Lower back stays flat on the floor the whole time.

LOWER.title: Lower - Machines
LOWER.notes: Maintenance, not growth. Machines only. Warm up with lateral band walks 2x20 each direction and glute bridges 2x12 before the first set.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.note: Feet mid-platform. Knees track over your second toe. Do not let the lower back round at the bottom.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
exercises.note: WEEK 3 ONWARD. Skip entirely in weeks 1-2.

exercises.name: Leg Extension (Machine)
exercises.note: Controlled. Pause a beat at the top.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (Machine)
exercises.note: Hamstrings. Slow on the way back.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Machine)
exercises.note: Knee protection. This is the machine version of the lateral band walk.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
exercises.note: Full stretch at the bottom, full squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise (Machine)
exercises.note: Bent knee hits a different calf muscle. Both variations stay in.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.note: Squeeze glutes. Do not let the hips sag.

weekly: waist at navel, morning, before food
per_session: duration and average HR (Garmin to Strava)

targets_12wk.bodyweight_lbs: 188-191, with more upper body muscle than at 197
targets_12wk.note: Bodyweight is a data point, not the goal. Waist and the mirror decide.

non_training: Two to three phone meetings a day taken walking. Audio-only calls do not need a chair.
Standing desk from 20% to 40% of the day.
Ask the doctor about ApoB on the next lipid panel, and about whether a calcium score fits your history.
